messages:
Leah: Quick sync after today's regional failover exercise. Goal: capture outstanding remediation items, owners, and short ETAs. Note recurring patterns: DNS TTL lag, cache cold-start, and metadata restore ordering.
Tom: I'll own DNS / routing validation. Plan: verify BGP/ASN announcements, check global LB health checks, and run synthetic failover from eu/na/ap regions. ETA Tue 2026-03-31.
Diego: Taking backups & restore ordering. Found issue where snapshot metadata applied after DB restore causing time drift. I'll update /runbooks/dr/restore-order.md with ordering and explicit chron checks (unix ts compare). ETA Mon 2026-03-29.
Nina: Observed cache storm on cutover (top-requests fanout). Proposed throttled fanout + incremental prime window. I'll prototype rate-limited prefill in staging and post numbers. ETA Thu 2026-04-02.
Vik: I'll validate KMS key access and rotation for backups, and run an encrypted restore dry-run. Will post results + error logs. ETA Sun 2026-03-28.
dr-bot: Note: incident-sim run recorded 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC; artifacts uploaded to <https://artifacts.internal/redwood/dr-sim-0318>.
Leah: Consolidated action items for tracker (please add ticket links):
  • DNS & routing validation — Tom — 2026-03-31 — add canary + healthcheck baselines
  • Backup restore ordering — Diego — 2026-03-29 — add chron check + sample commands
  • Cache prefill/throttle — Nina — 2026-04-02 — staging perf report
  • Backup KMS & encryption — Vik — 2026-03-28 — rotations + access matrix
  • Runbook walkthrough + owners list — Leah — 2026-03-30 — invite SMEs for review
Tom: Quick note: we saw a 90s DNS propagation window in us-west during the sim. Will add DNS TTL recommendations (lower pre-cutover, sweep post-cutover).
Diego: Example verification commands I'll add: `pg_restore --list` and `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-db-backups-prod/2026-03-18/` plus `jq` checks on metadata.json.
Nina: Prefill plan: precompute top-100 keys via recent-access table, seed to cache for 10min after failover, then ramp. If staging shows <15% cold miss, we keep defaults.
Vik: KMS dry-run failed on first try due to missing IAM role for restore-runner. I've created ticket INFRA-2297 and added a temporary policy. Will re-run and post logs here.
Leah: Please paste ticket IDs next to items. Also we should pick a date for a focused game-day to validate all items end-to-end. Suggestions?
Tom: 2026-04-08 looks free for infra + storage. I can block a 2h window.
Diego: +1 for 04-08. I'll schedule time to run full restore with metadata sequencing.
Nina: I'll prep a short playbook for cache priming steps and join the game-day run.
Leah: Great. Action owners, update this thread with ticket links and any blockers by EOD. I'll turn this into a short tracker doc and sync with execs next week. :white_check_mark:
